FAQ & How-To Guide
▸Exploring an artist's jukebox
From the home grid, tap any artist card to expand it, then hit Explore artist jukebox → to dig in (or ▶ Play to start listening right away).
  • Up top, the Sort menu and Card Size buttons (Artist Name Only · Total YT Plays · Full Details) change how the grid looks.
  • Inside an artist's jukebox, the view toggle switches the layout: By Year, Timeline, By Views, Albums List, and All Tracks.
  • The bar-chart toggles below recolor the bars by metric — Total YouTube Views, Jukebox Score, Jukebox Plays, My Jukebox Plays (when signed in), or Hide Bars to turn the chart off entirely.
  • Use Expand All Tracks / Collapse All Tracks to open or close every song at once.
▸Playing & queuing songs
Click any song to get a Play Now / Add to Queue popup.
  • Play Now starts the track immediately; Add to Queue drops it at the end of your up-next list.
  • The queue panel under the player lets you reorder, remove, or clear tracks — and you can save the whole queue as a playlist to come back to later.
▸My Jukebox vs Explore Artists
  • Explore Artists is the front door — the full community grid: every artist people have added from YouTube, with discography views, charts, and Add Artist. Free forever.
  • My Jukebox is your personal shelf — continue listening, favorites, playlists, and artists you have added or uploaded background-play audio for.
▸Adding artists & background audio for mobile
Hit ＋ Add Artist to the Jukebox on Explore Artists to grow the collection.
  • Type an artist name to auto-match, or paste a YouTube playlist link to import it manually.
  • YouTube playback works free on desktop and phone. To keep music going with the screen off, sign in and upload your own audio file for a track, then tap Enable Background Play on your phone.
  • Signed-in accounts get 500 MB of personal storage for uploads. You must own the rights to personally stream what you upload. Public play for everyone else is a separate, optional checkbox with an extra confirmation.
▸Sharing playlists & jukebox pages
  • Use the ⤴ Share button in the header to share the current playlist — anyone with the link can open it and press play.
  • Every artist has its own shareable jukebox page at sufferingjukebox.stream/artist-name. While you're exploring an artist, just copy the URL from your browser's address bar to send their whole jukebox to a friend.
▸Customizing your jukebox
  • Tap the ✕ in the corner of any artist card to hide it from your grid. Hidden artists are remembered on your account and stay hidden after you sign back in.
  • Changed your mind? Restore anything you've hidden under the account menu → Manage My Jukebox.
